sidebar.label: Accounts
sidebar.unofficial: Unofficial app, not affiliated with WhatsApp.

empty.title: No accounts yet
empty.body: Add a WhatsApp account to get started. Each account is isolated, so you can be signed in to several at once.
empty.select: Select an account on the left.

overlay.error: Could not load WhatsApp. Check your connection and try again.

wizard.title: Add account
wizard.name: Name
wizard.step1: WhatsApp Web will open with its own QR code.
wizard.step2: On your phone open WhatsApp, then go to Linked devices and tap Link a device.
wizard.step3: Scan the QR code shown by WhatsApp in this window.
wizard.errorLimit: You have reached the maximum number of accounts.
wizard.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

confirm.removeBody: "{{name}}" will be removed and its saved session data deleted from this computer. You will need to scan a QR code again to re-add it.
